snippet.title: Neocron Cyberpunk MMORPG Trailer (2000)
snippet.description:
Neocron - By the end of the third millenium, Earth has changed... Global pollution, excessive wars and a perforated atmosphere have turned the planet into an almost lifeless sphere of toxic mud. Radiation is everywhere and most animals have either gone extinct or have mutated into bizarre monstrous creatures. The remnants of mankind seek protection from the desolate, scorched world and gathered behind the protective walls of giant cities. These few mega cities became the last lights of hope, in the darkness of Earth's final dusk...

This is old findings from the original FTP archive of our old games site. This was available for download back then in the FTP in 2001.
Check also:
https://www.youtube.com/user/wwweDomenet
Please subscribe:
https://www.youtube.com/user/jukkaokauppinen?sub_confirmation=1 

Published by
CDV Software Entertainment AG
Developed by
reakktor.com
Released
Nov 17, 2002
Platform
Windows

Play with (and against) thousands of players online in the post apocalyptic world of the 28th century. You become a citizen of one of the last mega cities on Earth (Neocron) and it is up to you whether you want to experience exciting adventures or just lead a normal life in this virtual world.
--
These are old video files from our original FTP archive, eDome.net, from around 1998-2001. It was a popular gaming destination with news, reviews, articles, online games, servers and FTP file service. Some of the FTP site content survived in backups after the site was closed. So if the file is low resolution or horrible, that's because this is how the file was published & available for download in 1998-2001 era.
